purpose: Independent user-confirmed helmet references and provenance for accepted-only fixtures. Historical replay expectations are reproducibility baselines, not accuracy targets.
inputPolicy: Original Normal rows with a nonblank itemName and null rejectionReason; original row order, timestamps, slots, quantities and confidence values. No OCR rerun, inferred missing rows, quantity repair or target-total input. Missing quantity is represented by ?.

independentReference.provenance: User-confirmed in-game loot total, independent of OCR and replay output.

historicalAcceptedOnlyReplay.purpose: Historical reproducibility only; the quantity differs from the independent accuracy reference.
